scope: Single source receiver m1-natural, seeds 2026092701/02/03, full three-view PAMF including reference response. Main split excluded. Historical and immediately preceding target outcomes were exposed, so all target results here are development evidence.
motivation: A fixed source-only diagnostic of 12 frozen models on 5400 source-V samples per model found threshold-0.95 acceptance above 99% and very few accepted errors; source-L anchored four-of-five branch votes reduced the observed accepted error count in most cases. This uses a full-L bank and a bounded-echo proxy; it does not establish hidden-U accuracy or the minibatch training gate's coverage. Avoid asserting that high-confidence source pseudo labels are generally inaccurate.
method: Retain the preceding day_physics architecture, training budget, source contracts, raw pseudo-CE/KL acceptance mask, original Tri objective, separate branch gradient guard and weak physical As schedule. In each U batch, compute the same-source-L, cross-day five-branch centroid votes for every source-U raw input and its bounded-echo view. Only the Tri source-day feature style pairs, joint contrast/extrapolation and the five-path contrastive relation use a certified subset of the original threshold-0.95 accepted pseudo samples; ordinary pseudo-CE/KL retains all originally accepted samples. The branch arm requires at least four of five raw feature votes. The echo arm requires that same raw criterion and at least four votes after bounded echo. The two evaluation probes are detached and use no U truth or target data. Different source days are not new receivers.
initialization: Each of six candidates starts from its own same-setting same-seed original Tri source-only E20 and continues 10+20 epochs to fixed E50, 11100 total updates. No checkpoint selected using target results.
evaluation: All six fixed candidate prediction sets are frozen before independent truth-last scoring. Clean and six practical scenes; m1-natural matched physical IDs, three seeds; DURA-LU primary and DURA-L/raw secondary, plus cross_date and cross_rx/cross_both separately. Report per seed, scene, TX/RX/day and same-packet gains/losses. No leo_weak, target-driven checkpoint selection, or selective reruns.
success: Greater than 2 percentage points above ordinary PL for clean and every practical DURA-LU scene, and improvement over original Tri. Three-seed means and each seed/scene are reported. Results in this exposed setting cannot prove performance on other splits or independent samples.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --certified-day --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
environment: N607 ordinary account, immutable release and unique run/output root; real-checkpoint no-query smoke for all six rows.
resources: GPU 0–7, at most two observed/pending processes per GPU including other owners.
stop_rule: Any systemic technical failure stops new dispatch; healthy workers and all artifacts are preserved.
expected_artifacts: Six real-E20 no-query smoke checks with active certified cross-day pairs
Six own E30/E50 models and certificate/gradient counters
Six frozen seven-scene predictions and independent matched scores
